en.title: Buying a Dengfu frame: a precise quote matters more than a tempting starting price
en.description: How to contact Dengfu through its official route, specify the frame and cockpit, confirm stock and keep older owner accounts in context.
en.intro: A manufacturer inquiry is a conversation about one configuration. To make a Dengfu order useful, turn that conversation into a specific package, a delivery plan and an agreed rule for substitutions.

sections.heading: Identify the exact frame on the manufacturer’s site
paragraphs: Start from [Dengfu’s manufacturer site](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/) and the exact product page, such as the [R20 gravel frame](https://www.dengfubikes.com/Road-Frame/R20.html). Use the contact route provided there rather than a payment address copied from an old forum message.

Give the seller the model, current revision, size, finish and destination. Ask for the current geometry, package contents and assembly documentation. If an exact specification is not published, request it; do not borrow it from another Dengfu model.
The R20 photo here is a current product reference. The older owner accounts below concern other frames and do not establish how the R20 rides, fits or is supported.

sections.heading: Make substitutions opt-in
paragraphs: Separate frame availability from the availability of the cockpit, seatpost and hardware in your package. Ask which items are physically ready and which need production. A complete package is only as ready as its last required part.

State that a different cockpit dimension, frame revision or finish needs your approval before dispatch. If a preferred part is unavailable, compare waiting, choosing an approved alternative or cancelling under the agreed terms.
A bar that is ten millimeters different may be acceptable after a fit review—or may undo the reason you chose the frame. It is not a decision to delegate accidentally through a vague invoice.

sections.heading: Use a dated order report for the questions it raises
paragraphs: A direct-frame owner story is most useful when it identifies the model, order date and destination. Positive early riding impressions can be encouraging, but they are a different kind of evidence from a completed delivery record or a long-term assessment.

In a [December 2020 ordering discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,2.315.html), a buyer in Germany reported ordering a Dengfu R12 directly from China while sourcing another brand’s frame from a Spanish warehouse. That establishes the reported buying route, not a final delivery date or import cost.

For your purchase, look for a recent report matching the model revision, seller and destination. When that match is missing, keep the uncertainty visible rather than turning unrelated happy owners into a guarantee.

sections.heading: Ask for one invoice that answers the whole order
paragraphs: Request separate prices for the frame package, selected finish, any extra parts, shipping and the seller’s handling of import charges. Ask when production begins, when dispatch is expected and how a delay will be communicated.

Get the exact model’s warranty and damage-on-arrival process in writing, including the return destination and transport responsibility. Brand-level wording alone may leave important frame-specific details unresolved.

Have the final component list reviewed before paying, and compare the finished build cost with alternatives. The attraction of factory ordering is control over the project; clear specifications are what make that control real.

zh-Hans.title: Dengfu 车架购买指南：准确报价比起价更重要
zh-Hans.description: 通过 Dengfu 官方渠道询价，明确车架与把组、确认库存，并正确理解较早车主经历。
zh-Hans.intro: 向厂家询价，是围绕一个具体配置展开沟通。买 Dengfu，要把沟通变成明确套餐、交付计划，以及替换配置的约定。

sections.heading: 先在厂家网站确认准确车架
paragraphs: 从 [Dengfu 厂家网站](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/)及准确商品页开始，例如 [R20 砾石车架](https://www.dengfubikes.com/Road-Frame/R20.html)。通过页面提供的渠道联系，别使用老论坛消息里的付款地址。
说明型号、当前版本、尺码、涂装和目的地，索取当前几何、套餐内容及装配资料。未公布的准确规格应询问，不能借用另一款 Dengfu 车架。
这里 R20 照片是当前产品参考。后文老车主经历涉及其他车架，不能证明 R20 的骑行、合身或售后表现。

sections.heading: 替换配置必须先获得同意
paragraphs: 区分车架库存与套餐中的把组、座管、硬件库存。问哪些已经备好，哪些仍需生产。完整套餐是否准备好，取决于最后一件必需品。
明确把组尺寸、车架版本或涂装变更须在发货前经你同意。首选缺货时，比较等待、认可替代品，或按约定取消。
把组差十毫米，经合身评估后可能可以接受，也可能破坏选这款车架的理由。不应因为发票含糊，就无意中把决定权交出去。

sections.heading: 从有日期的订购记录里提炼问题
paragraphs: 直购车架经历在型号、下单日期和目的地明确时最有用。积极首骑感受令人期待，但它与完整交付记录、长期评估属于不同证据。
在 [2020 年 12 月订购讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,2.315.html)中，德国买家说 Dengfu R12 直接从中国订购，另一品牌车架则来自西班牙仓。这能说明其报告的购买路径，却不能证明最终签收日期或进口费用。
自己的购买应尽量找近期、同版本、同卖家、同目的地报告。找不到对应证据时，保留不确定性，别把不相关的满意车主变成保证。

sections.heading: 让一张报价单回答整笔订单
paragraphs: 分别列出车架套餐、所选涂装、额外配件、运费及卖家如何处理进口费用。问生产何时开始、预计何时发货，以及延误怎样通知。
书面取得具体型号保修与到货损坏流程，包括退货地点和运输责任。只有品牌层面的文字，可能仍不能解决型号相关问题。
付款前让装配者复核最终清单，再用完成后的总成本与其他方案比较。厂家订购的吸引力在于掌控项目，而明确规格才让这种掌控真正成立。
